**[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13)): DC 44 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 42 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 39 [Voricose](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2568) **Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 52 **Perception** +28; [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), painsight **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Infernal](/Languages.aspx?ID=19), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8), [Shadowtongue](/Languages.aspx?ID=21) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +31, [Brewing Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +24, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +24, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +28, [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=9) +30, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +24, [Torture Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +26 **Str** +7 **Dex** +4 **Con** +6 **Int** +3 **Wis** +7 **Cha** +6 **Painsight** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48)) A velstrac automatically knows whether a creature it sees has any of the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9), [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11), and [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=42) conditions, as well as the value of those conditions. **Items** _+3 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greater frost](/Equipment.aspx?ID=296) [whip](/Weapons.aspx?ID=48)_ --- **AC** 37 **Fort** +27 **Ref** +25 **Will** +28 +1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=103) **HP** 275 , regeneration 20 (deactivated by good or [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379)) **Immunities** cold **Weaknesses** good 15, silver 15 **[Attack of Opportunity](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=3)**
Glimpse of Stolen Flesh (aura, divine, enchantment, fear, mental, visual) 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it sees pieces of its own body amid the interlocutor's form. The creature must succeed at a DC 33 Will save or become [stunned 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36). --- **Speed** 40 feet **Melee** whip +31 ([Disarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=175), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188), [Reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=196)), **Damage** 3d4+15 slashing plus 1d6 cold **Melee** claw +28 ([deadly 2d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Evil](/Traits.aspx?ID=64), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d8+15 slashing plus 2d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) **Divine Innate Spells** DC 36 - **Cantrips (8th)** [Stabilize](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) - **5th** [Breath of Life](/Spells.aspx?ID=29) - **6th** [Restoration](/Spells.aspx?ID=258) (×2) - **7th** [Regenerate](/Spells.aspx?ID=248) - **8th** [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) (×2) **Focus Gaze** ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [Fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The interlocutor stares at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The creature must immediately attempt a Will save against Glimpse of Stolen Flesh. In addition, if the creature was already [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36), on a failed save, it feels its internal organs twist and writhe, and is [clumsy 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) for 1 minute. After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the interlocutor's next turn. **Surgical Rend** This functions as the [Rend](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=30) ability, dealing claw damage. In addition, if the target is a living creature with organs and muscle, the interlocutor opens a precise wound. Until the creature is restored to its maximum Hit Points, thus closing the wound, Strikes against the creature deal 1d6 extra precision damage.
